source_title: Nothing’s Android 17 update arrives early for four more phones
source_excerpt:

Nothing has expanded its stable Android 17 rollout to four more smartphones.
The update is arriving ahead of the company’s original November schedule.
Nothing OS 5.0 introduces a redesigned interface, new customization tools, and camera improvements.
Nothing appears to have lost patience with its own Android 17 roadmap , and for once, that’s a scheduling problem phone owners will happily welcome. November hasn’t even arrived, yet the company is already handing out updates originally reserved for next month.
After kicking off its stable Nothing OS 5.0 rollout with the Phone 3 earlier this month, Nothing is now bringing Android 17 to four more devices: the Phone 3a, Phone 3a Pro, Phone 4a, and Phone 4a Pro.
Nothing’s official roadmap initially penciled all four for early November. However, newly published changelogs for the Phone 3a series , Phone 4a , and Phone 4a Pro confirm that the stable release is rolling out ahead of schedule.
Nothing OS 5.0 update brings more than a fresh Android version number. Nothing is giving its distinctive interface another coat of polish, led by a frosted-glass Translucent theme, redesigned Settings, smoother animations, and additional lock-screen customization.
There’s plenty happening beneath the visual makeover, too. Highlights include:
Smarter navigation : Split notifications and Quick Settings, bulk home-screen icon arrangement, and one-tap Bluetooth connections.
Fresh widgets : Collector, Away Time, and Glyph Timer widgets, alongside a dedicated Glyph app.
Camera upgrades : Dual-view video, improved zoom and recording, plus additional Tuning and Presets tools on the Phone 3a series.
Android 17 extras : Expanded dark theme, enhanced HDR brightness controls, improved Live Updates, and new privacy indicators.
The Phone 4a models also receive faster Essential Voice transcriptions.
Nothing is distributing these updates in stages, so don’t panic if your phone hasn’t received its invitation yet. You can check manually under Settings > System > System update .
Next on the calendar are the Phone 2a and 2a Plus, currently scheduled for mid-November. But given Nothing’s newfound enthusiasm for beating deadlines, it’ll be interesting to see whether those devices also get an early boarding pass.
